prompt:
Desktop web UI screenshot, 16:9 landscape, of Marketo's portfolio page as an overnight tote of the viewer's own holdings. Same visual world as the reference: warm newsprint paper #e6d8c6 with fiber grain, carbon ink #040303, extra-condensed athletic gothic for names (like Big Shoulders Display), Barlow Condensed agate labels, 3px solid black rules, square-cut everything, no rounded corners, no shadows, no glass. BTC silks red #e42c22 square; ETH silks blue #0756d0 square. Purse green #085324 for money only. This is a designed website, not a racetrack photo, not a poster.

The reference supplies palette, type, tote-row grammar, Hot Sheet overlay, ruled fill bar, and stamp character. Do NOT copy the reference content of a full public field (no GLAZE, HOLLOW, or a conditions bar of AGE CREATED PNL TVL). This tote is only horses the connected wallet holds.

STRUCTURE: (1) Thin masthead ~8% height: MARKETO left; weekday date; dreamDEX line; EN/ID chips; ENTER A HORSE at right. (2) Below a 3px ink rule, a RESULT LINE: YOUR BOOK, PnL +1,240.00 in purse green, CAPITAL AT RISK 4,500.00, inverted SYNTHETIC tags. (3) CONDITIONS chips: BACKED (pressed, ink fill, hot-sheet type), MINE idle, ALL idle. (4) The remaining viewport is a TOTE of four holdings as full-bleed rows: columns program number, silks, NAME, ROLE (BACKED or MINE), your shares, your PnL in green or ink, a ruled ink bar of capital vs that horse's vault. Rows: 1 WARDEN BTC BACKED, 2 KITE ETH BACKED, 3 ASH ETH BACKED, 4 REDLINE BTC MINE. (5) A Hot Sheet overlay (~40% width) has slid in from the RIGHT over the table, Hot Sheet #f3eadc + newsprint, 3px ink left edge: huge condensed WARDEN, BTC silks, YOUR SHARES 12.40%, YOUR PNL +820.00 green, amount underline, green rubber-stamp DEPOSIT, outlined WITHDRAW (1px ink, not filled). The left of the tote remains visible so this is overlay not a new page. REDLINE if opened would be watch-only; this overlay is the backed horse.

Visitor job (scan the book, then stamp or redeem the opened horse) must be readable from the image alone. No neon, no Inter, no fake press, no rounded corners, no dashboard cards.
